Major art institutions, such as the Louvre, the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), the Metropolitan Museum of Art, and others frequently have digitized versions of their collections available online. Additionally, public domain images of many famous paintings can also be found through services like Wikimedia Commons. If you are looking to create a flat representation of a famous painting with no border and a white background on your own, you could use image editing software like Adobe Photoshop or free alternatives such as GIMP to manipulate an existing digital copy of the painting to meet your requirements., generate a one liner title
